paragraphs: I'm Oskar, a software engineer with 5+ years of commercial experience building backend systems in Java. Most of that time went into microservices in fintech, working on payment processing and financial services, where reliability, security and clear communication matter.

I enjoy hard algorithmic problems and finding efficient solutions. I own the full cycle: system architecture, technical analysis, implementation, testing, production deployments and third-line support. I also design client-facing APIs and help clients integrate with them.
Next, I'm deepening my skills in cloud-native applications, containerization and scalable deployments. I work fluently with AI tools.
Outside of work I run, hike in the mountains, train martial arts, and cook. Programming stays a hobby too.
